claims.source_quote_ar: قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: (إِذْ عُرِضَ) : يَجُوزُ أَنْ يَكُونَ ظَرْفًا لِأَوَّابٍ
claims.claim_ar: «إِذْ» ظرف زمان (ظرف) — يجوز أن تكون ظرفًا لِـ(أَوَّابٍ).
claims.claim_en: The particle 'إِذْ' can function as a temporal adverb (zarf); it may be taken as a zarf governing a returning-action construction (i.e., 'ظرف لِأَوَّابٍ').
claims.needs_review_reason: The source uses 'يجوز' (it is permissible), not an absolute assertion; grammarians differ in analyses.

claims.source_quote_ar: وَأَنْ يَكُونَ الْعَامِلُ فِيهِ «نِعْمَ» وَأَنَّهُ يَكُونُ التَّقْدِيرُ: اذْكُرْ.
claims.claim_en: An elided imperative 'اذكر' is to be supplied (estimated) after 'إِذْ' (i.e., an implied command 'remember').
claims.needs_review_reason: The source indicates this as a possible (يجوز) estimation; the elision and supplied verb may be treated differently in other readings/analyses.
